measurement_scope: diagnosis only; no product source files modified; no fixes applied

methodology.harness: Production bench/longmemeval runner code exercised via go test with a -overlay injected diagnostic test (repo files untouched; overlay replaced runner_coverage_test.go with original content + instrumentation). The overlay replayed the exact Run() path: same ingestHistory grouping (1 FTS observation per dataset session), same adaptive retrieve() (bench/longmemeval/runner.go:232-266), same top-5 join as the judge input (runner.go:196-206), same fixed judge (bench/common/llm_judge.go, OLLAMA endpoint http://localhost:11434, model qwen2.5:7b-instruct, temperature=0, seed=42, format=json).

dataset.provenance: Runner-format conversion (id/category/chat_history) of longmemeval_s.json (xiaowu0162/longmemeval-cleaned, 277 MB), i.e. the SAME input the published first-eval/second-eval runs used. Conversion artifact left by the prior eval session; the conversion script itself is not persisted in the repository (reproducibility gap, see limitations).

sample.composition: All 100 questions of the published evaluation subset (dataset indices 0-99: 70 IE + 30 MR) PLUS 10 stratified TR (indices 233..350) and 10 stratified KU (indices 366..429) to cover the per-ability breakdown.
sample.note: TR and KU rows are 10-question stratified samples and carry sampling error; IE/MR rows are the full published subset.

instrumentation_output.go_test_command: go test -count=1 -v -timeout 45m -overlay .../lme-diag/overlay.json -run 'TestDiagLongMemEval$' ./bench/longmemeval (exit 0, 1171s, 120/120 records, 0 judge errors, 0 retrieval errors)
instrumentation_output.note: Scratch paths are session-temporary; every number quoted in this report is also embedded here so the report is self-contained.

class_definitions.corpus_miss: normalized gold answer substring absent from the question's own ingested haystack
class_definitions.query_starved_retrieval_miss: answer in corpus but the AND-sanitized FTS query returned 0 keyword candidates and no adaptive list rescued it
class_definitions.retrieval_miss: answer in corpus, >=1 keyword candidate, but no top-10 result's FULL content contains the answer
class_definitions.rank_below_top5: evidence in top-10 but outside top-5 (the judge input slice)
class_definitions.context_truncation_hidden: evidence session inside top-5 but the 300-char previews shown to the judge do not contain the answer span
class_definitions.judge_reject: answer span visible in judge input but judge score <= 0.5
class_definitions.pass: answer span visible and judge score > 0.5
class_definitions.judge_error / retrieval_error: judge or retrieval transport failure (measured: 0 occurrences)

stage_breakdown.note: LongMemEval paper stage methodology mapped onto what this harness can actually measure. The harness has NO reading/generation stage: the judge scores the raw retrieved context, so 'reading' collapses into judge-acceptance-given-visible-context.

funnel_first_100.interpretation: 20% of questions retrieve the evidence session into top-10, only 5% expose the answer span to the judge (25% of retrieved evidence survives the 300-char preview), and the judge accepts 3/5 of those; 5/95 blind guesses were accepted, summing to the published 8/100 = 0.08.

retrieval_relevance.measured: recall@10 = 20.0% (all120), identical to recall@5 because the adaptive pipeline almost never returns candidates beyond the keyword leg; 49.2% of questions get zero keyword candidates

judge_acceptance.measured: judge accepts 50.0% of questions where the answer span IS visible in its input (3/6) and 7.0% where it is NOT visible (8/114, blind guessing that inflates the score); judge JSON parsing failures = 0/120

ingestion_coverage.measured: gold answer present verbatim in own haystack for 71.7% of questions (mean answer-token coverage 0.80); 28.3% are corpus_miss and cannot be split between paraphrase, true absence, and ingest loss without the has_answer instrumentation the conversion dropped

dataset_fit.measured: the converted dataset carries 4 of the 5 LongMemEval abilities (IE/MR/TR/KU; ABS=0 questions) so abstention is unmeasured; the runner protocol scores raw retrieved context as the answer, i.e. the published 0.08 measures retrieval+judge acceptance, not question answering as defined by the LongMemEval paper

TR.note: 10-question stratified sample; 3/10 judge accepts occurred with NO visible evidence (blind guessing)

KU.note: 10-question stratified sample; highest cross-question contamination (mean 2.3 foreign results in top-5)

ABS.note: 0 abstention questions exist in the converted dataset (categories IE/MR/TR/KU only); the ability is unmeasurable with the current artifact
ABS.missing_instrumentation: dataset conversion must preserve abstention questions (upstream has_answer flags / answer_session_ids) before any ABS claim can be made

root_causes.name: Strict-AND FTS query semantics starve retrieval for natural-language questions
root_causes.contribution: Largest single class: 37/120 questions (30.8%) have zero keyword candidates; overall recall@10 is only 20.0%.
root_causes.mechanism: sanitizeFTS wraps EVERY whitespace term of the raw question in quotes and joins with AND, prefix-wildcarding only the last term (internal/store/search/store.go:493-524). A 49-session haystack essentially never contains every function word of a full interrogative sentence, so observations_fts MATCH yields 0 rows; PRF, topic-expansion and fact-key retrievers all start from those keyword results, so nothing rescues the query (store.go:604-636).
evidence_refs: offline own-haystack probe: 0/37 starved questions contain ALL question terms; dropping stopwords rescues 11/37
examples[1] (question 'What play did I attend at the local community theater?' -> 0 candidates, empty judge input)

falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Dropping English stopwords and/or OR-joining content terms before MATCH collapses the query_starved class and raises recall@10 well above 20% without hurting precision.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.probe: Re-run the identical 120-question overlay diagnostic with a patched sanitizeFTS (content-term extraction, OR join) behind an env flag; compare class counts.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.expected_observable: query_starved_retrieval_miss <10% (from 30.8%) and retrieval_recall_at10 >=40%; if starved stays >25%, the hypothesis is refuted and the AND semantics are not the binding constraint.

root_causes.name: 300-char result previews hide retrieved evidence from the judge (no reading stage)
root_causes.contribution: 18/120 questions (15.0%) had the evidence session inside the top-5 yet the answer span absent from judge input; only 5.0% of all questions have the answer visible, i.e. 75% of correctly retrieved evidence is discarded before scoring.
root_causes.mechanism: Every retrieval path truncates result.Content to a single 300-char window anchored at the first query-term match (internal/store/search/store.go:368, :1043, :1749; window logic :552-595). The runner concatenates the top-5 previews as the ENTIRE system answer (bench/longmemeval/runner.go:196-206) - there is no answer-synthesis stage - so the judge scores ~429 average chars of chat transcript and rejects it.
evidence_refs: measured: 18/120 context_truncation_hidden; mean judge input 429 chars (max 1534)
measured: judge accepts 3/6 (50%) when the span IS visible vs 8/114 (7.0%) when not
examples[0] (evidence rank 1, answer verbatim in session, preview shows unrelated region)

falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Feeding the judge the FULL content of the top-5 observations (or an answer-synthesis pass over them) raises judge accuracy primarily through the previously-hidden evidence class.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.probe: Re-run the identical diagnostic with a flag that joins full observation content instead of previews (judge input budget permitting), holding model/seed fixed.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.expected_observable: context_visible rises from 5% to >=recall@5 (20%); of the 18 truncation-hidden questions at least half become visible and ~50-60% of those are accepted => overall accuracy >=15%. If visibility rises but accuracy stays <=10%, the judge/reading side (root cause 4) is the binding constraint instead.

root_causes.name: Strict-AND is compounded by cross-question corpus contamination (runner never scopes project)
root_causes.contribution: 40.8% of questions have at least one FOREIGN question's session in their top-5 (mean 1.13 of 5), 8.3% are fully foreign; contamination competes with the AND-starved candidates for the few available slots.
root_causes.mechanism: Run() ingests every question's haystack into ONE shared in-memory store with Project=q.ID but never passes SearchOptions.Project to search (bench/longmemeval/runner.go:232-240; filter support exists at internal/store/search/store.go:454-470). As the eval progresses, every query matches against all previously ingested haystacks; BM25 then surfaces unrelated sessions.

falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Setting SearchOptions.Project=q.ID in the runner removes foreign context and improves judge acceptance for questions that do retrieve evidence (KU is the worst case at mean 2.3 foreign top-5).
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.probe: Re-run the diagnostic with Project scoping; compare foreign_top5 and judge acceptance conditional on visibility.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.expected_observable: foreign_top5 -> 0 on all 120 and accept_given_visible >50% (from 50% overall, 0/1 on KU); if accuracy does not move, contamination is cosmetic and demoted.

root_causes.name: No reading/answer-synthesis stage: raw context is scored as the system answer
root_causes.contribution: Structural ceiling: even with perfect retrieval the judge must find the answer inside a collage of transcripts; accept_given_visible is only 3/6 and judge_reject examples show it rejecting visible evidence as unrelated.
root_causes.mechanism: evaluateQuestion passes the concatenated top-5 raw contexts to the judge as 'System answer' (bench/longmemeval/runner.go:196-217); the LongMemEval paper's reading stage (answer generation from retrieved sessions) does not exist in the harness, so the fixed judge compares a transcript fragment against a short gold answer.
evidence_refs: measured: judge rejects 3/6 visible-evidence questions (incl. examples[4])
bench/common/llm_judge.go:120-131 (prompt expects an answer, receives context)

falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Supplying ORACLE evidence (gold session full text) as the judge input would yield >=80% acceptance with the same judge; if it does not, judge strictness rather than missing synthesis is the binding constraint.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.probe: One-shot oracle-evidence judge pass over the 120 questions: judge(question, answer, full text of sessions flagged answer-bearing in the source dataset).
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.expected_observable: oracle_acceptance >=80% confirms reading-stage absence as the residual bottleneck after retrieval fixes; <60% refutes and shifts rank to judge prompt/calibration (then re-design the prompt probe).

root_causes.name: Ingestion/answer coverage gap of 28% (corpus_miss) limits the ceiling before retrieval starts
root_causes.contribution: 34/120 questions (28.3%) have no verbatim gold answer in their own haystack; MR coverage is only 53% and TR 40% because their answers are synthesized conclusions rather than quotes.
root_causes.mechanism: Mixed and currently inseparable causes: (a) legitimately non-verbatim answers (multi-session reasoning, temporal math), (b) true absence (abstention-style), (c) conversion/ingest loss. The conversion dropped the upstream has_answer flags, so the split is undetermined (see undetermined[0]).
evidence_refs: measured: corpus_miss 34/120; per-ability exact-substring coverage IE 81.4% / MR 53.3% / TR 40% / KU 90%
examples[3] ('February 14th' absent as substring while tokens occur separately)
upstream longmemeval_s.json carries per-turn has_answer flags that the runner-format conversion discarded

falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.hypothesis: Most corpus_miss is paraphrase (answerable but not quotable), not ingest loss; true absence is small and overlaps the unmeasured ABS population.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.probe: Re-convert the dataset preserving has_answer flags and answer_session_ids, then classify each corpus_miss question as (i) answer session flagged but text differs = paraphrase, (ii) no flagged session = true absence/ABS, (iii) flagged session missing from store = ingest bug.
falsifiable_fix_hypothesis.expected_observable: If (iii) >5% an ingestion bug is promoted to a top root cause; if (ii) clusters into ABS, the fix is dataset-fit (add ABS questions), not retrieval. Until run, no fix task may be created from this class.

undetermined.class: corpus_miss internal split (paraphrase vs true absence vs ingestion loss)
undetermined.missing_instrumentation: has_answer / answer_session_ids preserved through dataset conversion, plus stable-ID evidence spans (bench/longmemeval/baseline_adapter.go:40-54 documents that upstream provides NO Cortex stable relevance IDs)
undetermined.rule: No speculative fix task may be created from this class until the re-conversion probe runs (root_causes[4] probe).

undetermined.class: reading-stage quality isolated from retrieval (paper stage 3)
undetermined.missing_instrumentation: the harness contains no answer-generation stage at all, so 'evidence present but answer wrong' cannot be separated from 'judge rejects raw context' without adding a synthesis seam
undetermined.rule: Recorded as structural absence (root_causes[4] names the oracle-evidence probe); no reading-stage fix task may be created from this report.

undetermined.class: BM25 document-length normalization vs session-decomposition granularity
undetermined.missing_instrumentation: runner records no per-candidate score breakdown (domain.SearchScoreBreakdown is not surfaced by the bench harness), so long-session rank penalty cannot be quantified
undetermined.rule: Indexing granularity is NOT claimed as a root cause; only probeable by surfacing ScoreBreakdown in instrumentation first.

undetermined.missing_instrumentation: 0 ABS questions in the converted dataset artifact
undetermined.rule: No ABS score or fix may be claimed until the dataset re-conversion includes abstention questions.

undetermined.missing_instrumentation: TR/KU measured on 10-question samples (TR accepted 3/10 with no visible evidence); need the full 133+78 questions to quantify per-ability false-accept rates
undetermined.rule: TR 30% accuracy is measurement noise from blind accepts, NOT evidence of temporal-reasoning strength.

ranked_summary: 1. Strict-AND FTS query semantics: 30.8% of questions get zero keyword candidates (largest class, measurable headroom)
2. 300-char preview truncation + absent reading stage: 75% of retrieved evidence never reaches the judge; only 5% of questions have the answer span visible
3. Cross-question contamination: 40.8% of top-5s contain foreign sessions (runner omits Project scoping)
4. Raw-context-as-answer judge protocol: accepts only 50% even when evidence is visible; oracle-evidence probe required to size it
5. Corpus coverage gap 28.3%: ceiling before retrieval, internal split undetermined pending has_answer re-conversion
limitations: All numbers come from one deterministic run (judge temperature=0, seed=42; retrieval has map-iteration tie ordering in ingest, so session ingestion order is not byte-reproducible across runs).
answer_in_corpus uses exact normalized substring; token-coverage (mean 0.797) is reported alongside as a looser proxy; neither equals 'answerable'.
TR and KU rows are 10-question stratified samples.
The AND-starvation probe is an offline approximation of FTS tokenization (word-set membership), not an FTS execution.
The conversion script that produced the runner-format dataset is not in the repository (artifact-only provenance).
Judge input for empty retrievals is the empty string; the fixed judge scores those 'incorrect' by absence of an answer, consistent with production behavior.
